scope: Independent source pixels and actual local DAT license/closure. No models/sharedparts/registry edits, no physical acceptance.

findings.evidence: p5 doorway has 6 top studs, circular tube mount and 5-brick height; p6 inset explicitly blue2/yellow1 identical 45-degree ball-tube elbows. Local actual DAT official2025-03 CC BY4. p12 lid hinge is two axle liftarms, red hole bricks and grey axles, not a new hinge-box part.
findings.limitations: Tube orientation and port seating require owner real-geometry calculation; no physical fit claim.

findings.evidence: p8 right repeat explicitly4 pulley/string/hook assemblies; p9 four suspended hooks; p10 two square8x8 basket plates plus8 striped fences. Source shape supports existing real hooks and basket parts.
findings.limitations: Cord route/length and basket load-bearing remain manual; component+assembly inventory must not double count.

findings.evidence: p12 repeat explicitly2 pulley/string/hook assemblies; p13 two hooks connect door ends to upper winding assembly.
findings.limitations: Keep source door/hook placement with explicit unsupported cord constraint; no physical support validation.

findings.evidence: One short-crossbar hook visibly suspended; blue top brick square bottom notch supports6394, not round11198.
findings.limitations: Only these pages counted; exact string winding/length unresolved.

findings.evidence: Both source insets show6 red4x2x3 frames with white4-pane leaves. Upper panes taller than lower, almost flat rounded top, right double hinges. Existing official candidates differ:4809 near-equal panes;31022 tall upper panes but arched top;90265 flat rounded top but equal panes. Frame hinge-depth variant not distinguishable.
findings.limitations: Do not claim all candidates missing geometry. Frame primary144LDU load-bearing size is shared but exact frame identity remains unresolved. Any installed candidate must be explicit, not a confirmed substitution.

findings.evidence: Final orange cockpit/cream curved canopy visually same broad family as prior cleaner/hovercraft. Local31196c01 header explicitly local photo-informed4x6 and unverified sockets/hinge, while6345 has official geometry.
findings.limitations: Final view alone does not prove exact cockpit footprint or interface. Preserve owner source-inset review and approximation/collision risks.

findings.evidence: Final shows two red printed eye bricks; final pixels do not establish exact decorated part number.
findings.limitations: No new part invented or substituted; owner should inspect relevant material page.

findings.evidence: Final views show existing gears, shafts, liftarms, hole bricks and conventional blocks.
findings.limitations: Overview only; this does not certify BOM, source steps or assembly.
